Definition: a Shimronite (collectively) or descendants of Shimron
BiblicalUsage: The Shimronites are the family of Shimron the son of Issachar. They are counted in the wilderness census, one family among the sons of Issachar.
TheologicalSignificance: The Shimronites stand in their place among the sons of Issachar, and the census keeps them there.
